projection_steps: 1 · Define the evidence boundary
Fix geography, period, vintage and publisher for every input. City, county, metro, CSA, region and parcel are never mixed.
Prevents the single largest source of false precision in this file.
CITY
2 · Anchor demand on observations
Use Census population / households / income and BLS employment / wages / prices as dated observations only.
Each is a published official observation with a stated vintage.
COUNTY
3 · Bound escalation with published inflation
CPI-U +3.7% and ECI +3.9% bound a cost-escalation assumption; no official source supplies this lease's escalator.
Bounds, not forecasts; the lease clause is unverified.
BLS
4 · Bound discounting with the risk-free rate
Use the 10-year Treasury (4.88% on 2026-11-09) as a floor for any discount rate, not as a cap rate.
The series is daily, official and reproducible.
FRED
5 · Use only official long-range projections
SCAG's adopted 2024 forecast supplies regional employment and population to 2050 with stated uncertainty.
It is a statutory planning forecast, but it is six-county, not parcel level.
SCAG
6 · Keep official agency vintages separate
Census V2025 and CA DOF February-2026 estimates of the same county differ; label each and never average them.
Different methodologies and reference dates; see Flagged for Review.
DOF
7 · Model contractual cash flows only
Use executed rent through the verified term, confirmed unreimbursed expenses and verified debt; no extrapolated local growth.
Any other input would be an assumption, not evidence.
SECQ3
8 · Apply statutory transaction costs
Apply Prop 13, the city base tax, Measure ULA thresholds and the county documentary tax as published rules.
All rates are verified from the taxing authorities.
ULA
9 · Test tax outcomes explicitly
Apply federal capital-gain / §1250 rules, §1031 deferral and California ordinary-income treatment to the owner's real figures.
Owner basis and marginal rates are private and remain blank.
IRS409
10 · Stress business-as-usual cases
Re-run under vacancy, a higher exit yield, cost inflation above escalators and a failed marketing period.
Scenario stress needs no invented probability.
FRED
11 · Stress black-swan cases
Re-run under earthquake, wildfire, flood, correlated disruption, tenant failure and insurance repricing using observed official severity.
Severity is observed; frequency at this parcel is not published.
UCERF3
12 · Withhold uncalibrated outputs
No sale price, cap rate, renewal probability or 2030-2035 property value is published. No model was trained or back-tested.
A numerical result produced without parcel inputs would be an artefact of the rule, not evidence.
FRED
13 · Monitoring rule
Re-read each official release on publication, retain the prior vintage, and log every change with its link.
Rolling sources (BLS summary, FRED, ULA thresholds, FHSZ maps) change over time.
